column6: No verified postMessage/param API to pre-load content into the vendored WordCraft iframe (see inventory.csv). Do not guess at engine internals or modify the vendor bundle. Instead: generate a fresh .docx client-side (docx lib) and offer it as a download; user opens it themselves via WordCraft's own Open-file UI. Still flag-gated and additive.

reason: Same constraint as Word (GridCraft iframe). Generated via exceljs with real formulas (not baked-in totals).

column6: Same iframe-injection constraint as Word/Excel AND no .pptx generation library exists in the repo (no pptxgenjs, no equivalent). Hand-rolling raw OOXML .pptx zip XML for an unattended overnight pass is new, unverified infrastructure with no test harness to validate it opens correctly in PowerPoint/DeckCraft - too risky to ship even behind a flag. Content (content/office.slide.pih_ecosystem.vi.v1.md) is drafted for BU review; no code/UI wiring was added. Revisit once a sanctioned pptx-generation dependency is approved.

reason: Direct extension of the EXISTING sample mechanism (editor-samples.ts / createEditorSample) - one more button, same pattern, flag-gated.
QuickToolShell's existing (previously unused) pickerExtra slot takes a sample button with no change to the shell, ToolFlow, or task engines.
Canvas-drawn synthetic receipt image (not a photo, no face, no real company) fed through the same pickerExtra slot; real Tesseract OCR engine reads it unmodified.

Tool direction is PDF -> Word/Excel/image (not the reverse). Sample is a synthetic PDF company profile; converting it to Word satisfies the spec's intent ("Convert -> LPC profile DOCX") as an output, not an input format.
Prefills the existing form state (setForm) with a `text`-kind payload (not a `url`), so there is no live address to host, validate, or let go stale - the demo label is inside the encoded text itself.

column7: RemoveBackgroundPage ALREADY has a generic "try a sample" affordance (sample() fetching a shared placeholder image) that produces a natural before/after view. Duplicating this with a second, PI-Holding-specific placeholder image would add risk (another synthetic asset to source/review) for no real gain over what already ships. Decision: leave as-is; content drafted for completeness only.

IdPhotoPage ALREADY has a generic sample (ImageStudioUpload onSample/sampleUrl, same shared placeholder as above). A face/ID-photo template has no natural PI-Holding branding opportunity anyway (a demo face photo isn't a brand case study). Leave the existing generic sample in place.

reason: No NAS or shared-drive feature exists anywhere in the repo. The closest thing (features/cloud, SavedPage) is Pro-tier, per-account, paid cloud storage backed by a real MySQL table and a real user session - wiring demo content into a paid per-user data store would be out of scope and risky (could be mistaken for a real saved result). Per the spec's own instruction, marked N/A with reason rather than building new NAS-like infrastructure.
Two synthetic PDF contract versions (A/B) with deliberate, verifiable differences (term length, value, one added clause) through the same pickerExtra slot as merge/split.
